title: 124 Sunset Ridge Lane Vacation Rental
meta_description: 124 Sunset Ridge Lane is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Located in the heart of WaterColor’s Park District, 124 Sunset Ridge Lane combines timeless charm with modern comfort. Overlooking Crimson Park and just minutes from the Beach Club and Seaside, this elegant three-bedroom home offers a relaxed retreat ideal for families and friends.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 9 Passes Included 4-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Exterior Shower Fireplace Smart TVs in Family Room and Second-Floor Primary Suite Natural Gas Grill Parking for 2 Vehicles 4-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside 2-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access Experience the Home Welcome to 124 Sunset Ridge Lane, a beautifully designed WaterColor home that perfectly balances sophistication and comfort. Set on scenic Crimson Park, this inviting retreat features light-filled interiors, stylish décor, and thoughtfully designed spaces for both gathering and relaxation. The first floor opens to a spacious living area with cathedral ceilings, transom windows, and a cozy fireplace that sets a welcoming tone. The adjoining dining area and gourmet kitchen create a seamless flow for entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, including a Viking range and Sub-Zero refrigerator, and an expansive bar with additional seating. Also on the main level is a serene king guest suite with a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. A second bedroom with twin beds is conveniently located near a full hallway bath, and the nearby laundry room ensures everything stays fresh after a day at the beach. Upstairs, the private primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with a king bed, flat-screen TV, and shared en suite bathroom with a tub/shower combination. A charming alcove connected to the suite includes two twin beds, making it perfect for young children. A loft area with a twin daybed and TV provides extra lounging space for reading or relaxing. Outdoors, the front porch overlooks Crimson Park, offering plenty of seating for morning coffee or evening gatherings while children play nearby. With a 4-passenger electric cart and four adult bikes included, exploring WaterColor’s pools, Beach Club, and Seaside is simple and fun.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2), Hallway Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Alcove (Accessed Through Primary Bedroom): Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Loft Area: Twin Daybed (Sleeps 1) Life in WaterColor Perfectly positioned between the Beach Club and Seaside, 124 Sunset Ridge Lane places guests at the center of WaterColor’s coastal lifestyle. Enjoy morning strolls through Crimson Park, afternoons by the pool, and evenings exploring nearby restaurants and boutiques. This home offers comfort, location, and style—everything you need for a memorable 30A vacation.
